name.ja: HGBD 1/144 セラヴィーガンダムシェヘラザード

description.ja: セラヴィーガンダムベースの高火力カスタムガンプラがHGBDで登場！
description.en: High firepower custom Gunpla based on Seravee Gundam is now available in HGBD!

description.ja: • GNフィジカルバズーカをはじめ、多様な武装が付属！
description.en: • A variety of weapons are included, including the GN physical bazooka!

description.ja: • 背中、腰に装備されたGNコンテナビームは付け替えで砲撃形態や腕武装に変形可能で、付属パーツの付け替えで充実のプレイバリューを実現！
description.en: • The GN container beams installed on the back and waist can be changed into a bombardment mode or arm armament by replacing them, and the included parts can be replaced to achieve enhanced play value!
